name: gemex_full_physionet
cmd: export HF_HOME=/data/dan/hf_cache; unset HF_HUB_OFFLINE; python3 src/data_prep/build_gemex_cell.py --source physionet --max_words 12 --audit_overlap && echo GEMEX_BUILD_DONE

name: mdvqa_fetch
cmd: mkdir -p /data/dan/dataset/medical_diff_vqa && cd /data/dan/dataset/medical_diff_vqa && for f in mimic_pair_questions.csv mimic_all.csv; do [ -s $f ] || wget -q --timeout=120 --tries=3 https://physionet.org/files/medical-diff-vqa/1.0.1/$f; done; ls -la; echo MDVQA_FETCH_DONE

name: budget_matched_objective
cmd: export HEAD_SWEEP_THREADS=6 OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 MKL_NUM_THREADS=6; python3 -X faulthandler src/training_methods/head_sweep.py --stage budget --threads 6 --shard 0 --nshard 1

name: donor_curves_with_control
cmd: export HEAD_SWEEP_THREADS=6 OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 MKL_NUM_THREADS=6; python3 -X faulthandler src/training_methods/head_domain_curve.py --threads 6 --seeds 3 --out results/cascade_methods/artifacts/head_domain_curve_v2_2026-08-19.json && for DS in pathvqa_open_train slake_open_train kvasir_open; do python3 -X faulthandler src/training_methods/head_donor_hetero.py --domain $DS --threads 6 --seeds 3 --out results/cascade_methods/artifacts/head_donor_hetero_v2_${DS}_2026-08-19.json; done && echo DONOR_V2_DONE

name: eval_clustered_ci
cmd: export HEAD_SWEEP_THREADS=6 OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 MKL_NUM_THREADS=6; python3 -X faulthandler src/training_methods/head_eval_bce.py --stage eval --threads 6 --seeds 8 --bigtrain --out results/cascade_methods/artifacts/head_eval_bigtrain_clusteredCI_2026-08-19.json
